name: Postmodernism
overview: Scripture reveals that truth is absolute and grounded in God's unchanging Word, which endures forever (Psalms 119:160). Jesus Christ embodies this truth as the exclusive way to the Father and the source of life and freedom (John 8:32; John 14:6). Believers are called to be sanctified through God's truth and to resist conformity to worldly patterns by renewing their minds, discerning God's perfect will (John 17:17; Romans 12:2). Salvation is found only in the name of Jesus, affirming the exclusivity of the gospel amid competing worldviews (Acts 4:12).
